label: misaligned
reason: The independently acquired Morgan–Tian context defines distance from the Riemannian metric g and then uses its distance function in the weak Laplacian discussion. The selected definition uses LocallyLipschitz in the existing ambient MetricSpace M while separately using g for Laplacian and volume, without equating that ambient distance to the g-distance. Two distances can induce the same topology while changing local Lipschitzness (on R compare |x-y| and |x^3-y^3|, with f(x)=x near zero).
review_scope: Provisional mismatch is limited to the metric used by the Lipschitz regularity condition in the claimed Riemannian weak-Laplacian interface. Source Remark1.29 specifically discusses f=d_g(p,·); this generalized Lean definition and the broader arbitrary-f/h interface require human scope review. The test-integral expression is not alleged algebraically false.
